terms.gloss: bracket or support for the rod
terms.comment: Our description, the support of the rod; plural fulcra virgae. Classically fulcrum is the post or foot of a couch (Lewis & Short), from fulciō, to prop. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have words for the curtain (aulaeum, vēlum, Traupman 123, 300; cortīna, M-O s.v. curtain) but none for its fittings.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 123, 300.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. curtain.
